ModuleDescription: Unofficial Focus Vision-oriented derivative of HTC VIVE Streaming Face Tracking Module v1.7. Adds per-eye Openness/Blink clamping and independent Blink closure fallback.
UsageInstructions: Do not enable this module together with HTC's original ViveStreamingFaceTrackingModule; they share the same VIVE Streaming native SDK/IPC and can conflict. Disable or remove the original module first. Enable 'Streaming avatar data to VRChat via OSC' in VIVE Hub Console before using this module.
